hits.description:
Scr2ppm takes screenshots of your whole screen, a single window, or an area you select with the mouse.
      Start the app to get a small options window where you can choose:
      
        what to capture: the entire screen, a window, or an area
        an optional delay before the capture
        the image format: PPM, PNG or JPG
        whether the window should come back after each capture, which is handy for taking several screenshots in a row
      
      Your choices are remembered the next time you open the app. Screenshots are saved in your Pictures folder, and "Capture & Open" shows the result right away.
      While you drag out an area, hold the space bar to move the whole selection, and release it to continue resizing. The arrow keys nudge the starting corner, and a right click cancels.
      Need time to set things up first? Add a delay and a colored border around the capture area drains from red to blue, so you can see how much time is left.
      Works on X11 desktops.
hits.name: Scr2PPM

hits.description:
Typesetter es un editor de texto minimalista para crear bellos documentos con el lenguaje de marcado Typst.
      
        Interfaz adaptiva y amigable con el usuario: Enfoque en la escritura. Genial para papers, reportes, presentaciones, libros, y cualquier otro tipo de escritura estructurada.
        Impulsado por Typst: Un lenguaje para escritura basado en marcas de texto que combina la simpleza de Markdown con el poder de LaTeX.
        Completamente local: Tus archivos se mantienen en tu computadora. Sin compromisos con la nube.
        Gestión de paquetes: Instalar, eliminar y automáticamente obtener paquetes de Typst dentro de la aplicación.
        Plantillas: Crea nuevos documentos a partir de plantillas integradas o creadas por el usuario.
        Previsualización automática: Ves cómo queda tu documento mientras escribes.
        Clic-para-saltar: Haces clic en un lugar de la previsualización para saltar a la posición correspondiente en el archivo fuente.
        Lupa: Clic y mantener en la previsualización para inspeccionar los detalles finos.
        Revisión de accesibilidad: Simular diferentes formas de daltonismo para revisar cómo tus lectores verían tu documento.
        Desplazamiento Centrado: Mantiene tu escritura visualmente ajustada mientras digitas.
        Resaltado de sintaxis: Hace que tus documentos sean más fáciles de editar y leer.
        Sugerencias gramaticales: comprueba automáticamente si tu texto contiene errores gramaticales (por ahora, solo en inglés).
        Estadísticas de Documento: Calcula contadores de página, palabra y caracteres fácilmente.
        Navegación de comentarios: Observe todas sus notas y comentarios en un solo lugar y salte directamente a la fuente de cada uno.
        Rápido y nativo: Escrito en Rust y GTK.
hits.name: Typesetter
hits.summary: Editor de Typst para escribir sin distracciones

hits.description:
Dynamic playlists, integrated spectrum visualiser, background blur, synced lyrics & more.
      
        Features
      
      
        Both a self-contained music player and an MPD-compatible client. The power of MPD, without the manual set-up. Plays nearly every format, DSD included!
        Supports most MPD features, from queue reordering and ReplayGain to output control, crossfade and MixRamp.
        Genre & tag filtering, plus in-app tag editing.
        Client-side dynamic playlists: both query and sticker filter rules, multiple ordering clauses, fetch-first limits, scheduled refreshes, all via an intuitive editor UI.
        Fetch album arts, artist avatars and (synced) song lyrics from external sources (currently supporting Last.fm, MusicBrainz and LRCLIB).
        Configurable multi-artist and multi-genre tag splitting.
        Stay in control while in the background via MPRIS & XDG Background Portal.
        Customisable spectrum visualiser (FIFO or system PipeWire).
        Live bitrate readout + audio quality indicators (lossy, lossless, hi-res, DSD).
        Largely **zero-cost** static background blur.
        Volume knob with dBFS readout support ('cuz why not?)
        User-friendly configuration UI & GSettings backend
        MPD passwords are securely stored in your user's login keyring.
        Works with large playlists (tested with 30K songs).
        Commands are bundled into lists for efficient MPD-side processing where possible.
        myMPD-compatible stickers handling.
      
      This Flatpak installation bundles MPD 0.24 internally to serve as the playback engine for Standalone Mode.
      
        PipeWire permissions
      
      Euphonica requires PipeWire capture permissions for its PipeWire visualizer backend, but currently it is only possible to specify a "blanket" PipeWire permission that also allows screen recording, microphone access, etc. Euphonica does not make use of these extra permissions, and will be updated to use a more restricted "audio portal" when one becomes available.
      
        Screenshot content copyright information & disclaimer
      
      Album arts contained in the screenshots have been substituted with random photos from Pexel. All credits go to the original authors.
      Euphonica is solely a music player programme and does not provide any media content or sources. Users must provide their own content or manually configure Euphonica to access third party online services.
hits.name: Euphonica
hits.summary: Advanced music playback powered by MPD

hits.description:
Prelora is a task manager and timer app for your desktop, built around
      Getting Things Done. New tasks go into an Inbox, and you sort them into
      Next, Scheduled, Someday or Focus when you are ready. Countdown timers
      and reminders live in the same app.
    
      
      Your data stays on your own computer, where task and reminder text and
      attachments are encrypted. The app works offline.
    
      Free to use:
      
        Inbox, Next, Scheduled, Someday and Focus lists with no task limit
        Search, recurring tasks, and a Trash you can restore from
        As many countdown timers as you like, of any length
        Snooze buttons for 5 minutes, 30 minutes and 1 hour
        Calendar reminders with repeating schedules
        Backup, export, iCal and file attachments
      
      Prelora Pro adds:
      
        A Kanban board view
        Up to four custom snooze buttons, and typing your own extra time on a running timer
        More alert sounds
        A limit on how many times a timer can be restarted
        Webhooks that send task and reminder events to Slack or any HTTPS address
      
      
      Pro is paid in advance for a set period on the Prelora website and
      activated with a voucher code in Settings. It does not renew
      automatically.
hits.name: Prelora

hits.description:
Mirror Hall is an experimental app that aims to turn any Linux device into a
      second monitor.
    
      
      It is designed on both desktop and mobile devices, and supports both
      hardware-accelerated and software-based encoding to stream video efficiently.
    
      
      Mirror Hall makes use of a new, experimental GNOME feature to create virtual
      monitors, and requires UDP traffic to be allowed by the network and firewall.
      Support for other desktops will be added once a standardized API exists.
hits.name: Mirror Hall
hits.summary: Use Linux devices as second screens

hits.description:
The best way to play retro games online.
      Fightcade is a matchmaking platform for retro gaming, bundled with different emulators for seamless online play.
      Our main emulator is FightcadeFBNeo, built using latest FBNeo (0.2.97.44) with a custom and improved GGPO 
      implementation and a better rendering core, making it the current best netplay implementation for rollback-based P2P online play. 
      In layman terms, this means that demanding games in terms of input lag and responsiveness (such as fighting games) 
      can be played over the internet with very little perceivable lag.
hits.name: Fightcade

hits.description:
Haystack is a small GNOME application for editing OpenQA needles. A
       needle is a screenshot on which areas have been marked that must match
       with the output of a system under test in OpenQA.
      The application works on a local needles repository. You open the
       repository folder, select a needle to edit, and start drawing. You can
       also change the screenshot, either from a local file, or copy-pasting one
       from elsewhere (for example a failed test in OpenQA).
      For any feedback, questions or general issues, please file an issue on
       the GitLab page.
hits.name: Haystack
